title: Computational Simulations of Biofilm-Associated Proteins Generated by Pathogenic Escherichia coli Identified by MALDI-TOF-TOF Mass Spectrometry and Top-Down Protein Analysis.
authors: Koirala, Mahesh; Shi, Yanlin; Carter, Michelle Q; Fagerquist, Clifton K
journal: Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold3和分子动力学模拟研究致病大肠杆菌生物膜蛋白（含DNA结合蛋白HU）的结构与解折叠，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA核心体系，方法可迁移。
abstract: Five proteins extracted from bacterial biofilms of a pathogenic Escherichia coli strain were identified by MALDI-TOF-TOF mass spectrometry and top-down protein analysis. They are cold-shock proteins CspC and CspE, DNA-binding proteins HU-alpha and HU-beta and CsgA (the major subunit of curli). The fragmentation efficiency of these singly charged protein ions varied considerably. The pattern of fragment ions obtained from tandem mass spectrometry postsource decay of these protein ions was compared to in silico protein structures obtained using AlphaFold3 to better understand the factors that contribute to their gas phase dissociation as well as their likelihood of unfolding during MALDI sample preparation. Molecular dynamic simulations were performed to calculate the root-mean-square fluctuations (RMSF) of Calpha atoms and root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) of the protein backbone to assess their propensity to unfold/denature during MALDI sample preparation. A molecular dynamics simulation was performed on a curli multimer composed of one CsgB (the minor curli subunit) and five CsgA which showed rapid disintegration of this short curli complex in hexafluoro-isopropanol (HFIP) consistent with experimental observations. Strong hydrogen bonding of HFIP appears to disrupt the intermolecular hydrogen bonds of this amyloid protein complex but does not unfold CsgA monomer because of 138 intramolecular hydrogen bonds present in its solenoidal beta-sheet structure. Finally, electrostatic analysis of the curli complex reveals partitioned regions of positive and negative charge along the fibril axis that may facilitate its assembly.
abstract_zh: 从致病性大肠杆菌菌株生物被膜中提取的5种蛋白质，通过MALDI-TOF-TOF质谱法和自上而下蛋白质分析进行鉴定。它们分别是冷休克蛋白CspC和CspE、DNA结合蛋白HU-alpha和HU-beta，以及CsgA（curli的主要亚基）。这些单电荷蛋白质离子的碎裂效率差异显著。将串联质谱源后衰变获得的这些蛋白质离子的碎片离子模式，与使用AlphaFold3获得的计算机模拟蛋白质结构进行比较，以更好地理解影响其气相解离的因素，以及它们在MALDI样品制备过程中发生去折叠的可能性。进行了分子动力学模拟，以计算Calpha原子的均方根波动（RMSF）和蛋白质骨架的均方根偏差（RMSD），评估它们在MALDI样品制备过程中去折叠/变性的倾向。对一个由1个CsgB（curli次要亚基）和5个CsgA组成的curli多聚体进行了分子动力学模拟，结果显示该短curli复合物在六氟异丙醇（HFIP）中迅速解体，与实验观察一致。HFIP的强氢键作用似乎破坏了该淀粉样蛋白复合物的分子间氢键，但由于CsgA单体螺旋状β-折叠结构中含有138个分子内氢键，HFIP并未使其去折叠。最后，对curli复合物的静电分析揭示了沿纤维轴存在正负电荷的分区区域，这可能促进其组装。
